findings.title: Model router policy configures unlisted model glm-5.3:cloud

evidence.observation: Routing policy routes 'escalate' and 'fallback-complex' tasks to 'glm-5.3:cloud', but available_models only contains 'glm-5.2:cloud'.

proposed_action.description: Align routing_policy for 'escalate' and 'fallback-complex' to match available model 'glm-5.2:cloud' or configure provider credentials and catalogue registration for 'glm-5.3:cloud'.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents dispatch failures and unhandled runtime exceptions during task escalation and fallback operations.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: model_catalogue_drift; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.95; Risk: high; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Model installation/removal requires infrastructure planning

findings.title: Uncommitted source modifications on main branch

evidence.observation: Working tree is dirty with uncommitted changes across core/platform/interrupt_dispatcher.py and lcars-portal/src/app/captains-brief-workbench/_components/ItemRow.tsx.

proposed_action.description: Review, validate, and commit or stash pending modifications in interrupt_dispatcher.py and ItemRow.tsx to maintain repository determinism.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores deployment reproducibility and ensures Telegram message_id dispatch persistence fixes are tracked in git history.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: governance_violation; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.98; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Governance fixes require architectural review

findings.title: In-tree virtual environment chatterbox-venv unignored in repository tree

evidence.observation: Virtual environment located at core/voice/chatterbox-venv contains vendor site-packages and third-party test suites, swelling indexed Python files to 16,065.

proposed_action.description: Add core/voice/chatterbox-venv/ to .gitignore and audit exclusion paths to prevent third-party dependencies from skewing repo telemetry.

findings.expected_benefit: Eliminates audit noise, accelerates repository scanning duration, and avoids vendor code pollution.
